claims.text: An AI-generated doctor consult summary states the patient described chest discomfort on exertion, but notes duration and medication history were not discussed and clinician confirmation is required.

citations.quote: Patient described chest discomfort on exertion

open_questions: When was chest discomfort on exertion first recorded, and what did earlier entries say about its duration and character?
What medication history is documented, and were any medications started, stopped, held or changed around the chest discomfort?
Which cardiac tests, referrals or stress evaluations have been ordered or completed for this chest discomfort?
Are prior vital signs, ECG or troponin results recorded that relate to this symptom?
Are any allergies or allergic reactions recorded?
Were risk factors such as hypertension, diabetes, smoking or previous cardiac events recorded earlier?
Which follow-ups, referrals or tests are planned or outstanding?

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Chest discomfort on exertion is reported, but duration, character and medication history were not discussed in the AI-generated summary, which requires clinician confirmation.
